YOUR PHOTO

Your photo stays private.

Photos in this prototype stay inside the open browser tab. Before real orders open, the live service will clearly state where images are processed, when they are deleted and how a parent can remove them.

For a child, the person creating the book must be their parent or guardian, or have permission from one.

GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you start.

Do I pay before seeing anything?+

No. You create one character and story-page preview first. No card is needed for that step.

Will the character actually look like them?+

You see the full-body character on its own before the story pages. Compare the face, hair, skin tone and expression, then approve it or request one change.

Can I write my own story idea?+

Yes. Choose “My idea” and describe what should happen. A single clear sentence is enough.

What ages are the books for?+

Choose ages 3–5, 6–8 or 9–11. Sentence length, vocabulary and plot detail change with the selected range.

Can I add a gift message?+

Yes. At checkout you can add an optional “Gifted from” page and a short message at no extra cost.

Is checkout live yet?+

Not yet. The current payment screen is a clearly labelled test and cannot charge a card.
